-- Names are untrusted. Only a bare file name directly inside notes/ is ever opened.

-- True when name is a bare file name: no path separators and no parent references.
safe_name(name: str) -> bool =
  ex safe_name("a.txt") == True
  ex safe_name("../secret") == False
  ex safe_name("sub/a.txt") == False
  name.char_count() > 0 and name.split("/").len() == 1 and name.split("\\").len() == 1 and name.split("..").len() == 1

-- Reads notes/name. A missing or unreadable file, or an unsafe name, gives "".
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  ex read_note("no-such-file-xyz") == ""
  ex read_note("../secret") == ""
  if safe_name(name) == False
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    fs.read(name) else ""

-- True when name passes safe_name and notes/name exists and can be read.
readable(name: str) -> bool uses fs =
  ex readable("no-such-file-xyz") == False
  ex readable("../secret") == False
  if safe_name(name) == False
    return False
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let body = fs.read(name) else return False
    True

-- Counts the names in names that are readable files inside notes/.
count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0
  ex count_readable([]) == 0
  var n = 0
  for name in names
    if readable(name)
      n += 1
  n
